text: {"lessons":["Selling winners in small pieces felt rewarding, but it did not protect the account from later declines; I should set position and risk limits rather than rely on realized gains for reassurance.","After adding to Stocks A, C, and D, I held through a substantial portfolio drawdown without reassessing my exposure. I should review risk and diversification regularly, even when I dislike making a decision about a losing position.","A few months of gains or losses do not reveal what prices will do next. I should make future trades from a consistent plan, not from my average cost, the satisfaction of locking in gains, or recent account performance."]}
